verdict.rationale: Shared team workspaces are a fair question for a coding agent, but the evidence never documents creating a shared workspace from docs and repos. The closest items are adjacent: connecting a remote database instead of local SQLite, attaching project files with `@`, and requesting access to directories outside the project root. None of these is a team source-of-truth workspace.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
